cases.name: Commissioning with a refinancing cliff
cases.mechanism: Baseline commissioning, working-capital ramp, temporary revolving borrowing, optional Loan A prepayment and annual NOL creation and use. These required regimes must be measured for this case when the batch runs.

cases.name: Year-one bullet maturity
cases.mechanism: Move Loan B maturity into month 12 so its principal competes with commissioning liquidity and the first annual loss posting; provide an explicit eight-million-dollar revolving limit.

cases.name: Subsidized zero-interest Loan A
cases.mechanism: Offset the source borrowing-rate anchor with a negative spread to activate zero-rate Loan A amortization while preserving principal, cash-priority and annual tax rules. Verify that the resolved rate is actually zero.

cases.name: Short amortization during ramp-up
cases.mechanism: Use 18 amortizing payments under a publicly specified higher sales scale. Scheduled and optional principal must remain capped, and Loan A payoff must be demonstrated within the forecast.

cases.name: Commissioning crosses a tax year
cases.mechanism: Keep all twelve first-year months in construction, place the initial asset in service in month 13 and begin Loan A amortization then. Sales ramp, depreciation, interest-only debt service and annual loss recognition must use their stated periods.

cases.name: Binding annual NOL utilization cap
cases.mechanism: Increase the explicitly funded startup expense to build a larger loss vintage. The intended annual NOL cap must bind in a profitable year; reject or disclose an unmet regime instead of treating this design intent as a measured result.

cases.name: Initial-vintage depreciation cliff
cases.mechanism: Depreciate the initial asset over twelve service months, exhaust its basis and stop depreciation before the refresh service period. Preserve the independent vintage and annual tax timing rules.

cases.name: Refresh payment and service cross tax years
cases.mechanism: Pay for the refresh in month 15 but begin service in month 25. The cash-funded asset remains undepreciated during installation, and cash funding and the first depreciation posting occur in different tax years.

cases.name: Short-life refresh vintage
cases.mechanism: Depreciate the refresh over six service months, cap the final charge at remaining basis and stop further charges while the initial vintage continues separately.

cases.name: Full cash sweep allocation
cases.mechanism: Allocate all excess cash remaining after revolver repayment to Loan A, capped at remaining principal. Distribute any unused sweep after payoff. Require the full-sweep allocation regime and disclose actual payoff separately; payoff is not assumed by this configuration.
